name: Methodology pre-approval
gap_definition: MethodologyChange with no Approval, or Approval.at > MethodologyChange.effectiveAt

name: Post-change IPV
gap_definition: No IPVReview on the Position within slaDays after MethodologyChange.effectiveAt

name: Override beyond tolerance
trigger_condition: abs(mark - model) > thresholdBps OR deviation > pctOfBidAsk
gap_definition: PriceOverride above threshold without Approval within sla, or Approval without IPV challenge

name: Recurring overrides
trigger_condition: count(PriceOverride on same Position within windowDays) >= n
gap_definition: Nth override in window with no Escalation within sla

name: IPV divergence resolution
required_control: Escalation AND (Evidence of adjustment OR CHALLENGED_BY)
gap_definition: IPVReview above threshold followed by neither adjustment Evidence nor challenge nor Escalation within sla

name: Persistent unexplained P&L
gap_definition: Persistent PnLSignal with no attribution Control recorded within sla

name: Periodic review of illiquids
gap_definition: Illiquid Position with no MAPReview in period, or no MAPReview within regimeSlaDays after a regime-break event

name: Segregation of duties
required_control: approver <> position owner AND approver.desk <> position.desk
gap_definition: (a:Approval)-[:APPROVED_BY]->(p) where p OWNS the Position or belongs to the same Desk

name: Documentary evidence
gap_definition: Approval or Escalation node with no EVIDENCED_BY relationship
